chunks: And when they went back to their people turned to make fun of them;
ai.seo_question: How did the hypocrites behave after leaving the Prophet's presence?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological duality of the hypocrites, who perform ritual prayers merely to maintain social standing while internally mocking the faithful. Their 'joy' (fakihin) is not genuine contentment but a derisive amusement at the simplicity of the believers, illustrating the core trait of *nifaq* (hypocrisy) as a disconnect between outward form and inward intent. This behavior serves as a warning against performative piety that lacks sincere conviction.
